name: ninja
description: Lightning-fast build system focused on speed with minimal dependencies and parallel execution

ninja.description: Small build system with focus on speed - designed to be generated by higher-level build systems like CMake and Meson
ninja.usage:
ninja # Build all targets
ninja -j 4 # Build with 4 parallel jobs
ninja -t clean # Clean all build outputs
ninja -t graph | dot -Tpng -o graph.png # Visualize dependency graph
ninja -t targets # List all available targets
